answer: Sybil resistance utilizes Proof-of-Unique-Resource-Attestation. Each AI agent must digitally attest to ownership of a verifiable, scarce resource. An attacker requires a unique, non-reproducible resource for every fake identity. Imagine the cost: proving a specific sub-atomic ripple pattern, or attesting a unique saffron pigment's cryptographic hash, or associating an identity with a singular walnut's internal structure. Acquiring a multitude of such truly distinct and attestable physical or digital assets for each Sybil identity creates an economically insurmountable barrier.
